title: Youth mental health: prevention, support, and digital policy
discussion_signal: The OECD discussion calls for prevention, low-threshold youth-friendly support, attention to socioeconomic insecurity and bullying, rigorous evaluation of digital-policy effects, and stronger monitoring of youth mental health.
linked_research_question: How should prevention address cumulative youth pressure across school, family, work, housing, and digital life rather than treating mental health as an isolated clinical issue?
limits: The post is policy guidance and does not provide causal estimates
It does not show whether low-threshold services are available in practice
Institutional messaging may not capture young people’s own priorities
